description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown or when password hashes are obtained.
detection_examples: Multiple failed login attempts followed by a successful login.

description: Adversaries may abuse PowerShell commands and scripts for execution.
detection_examples: PowerShell execution with encoded commands or unusual arguments.

description: Adversaries may abuse the Windows command shell for execution.
Adversaries may abuse the Windows Task Scheduler to perform task scheduling for initial or recurring execution of malicious code.
detection_examples: Creation of scheduled tasks using schtasks.exe.

description: An adversary may attempt to get detailed information about the operating system and hardware.
Adversaries may attempt to get information about running processes on a system.
detection_examples: Execution of tasklist or similar commands.

description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services listening on remote hosts.
detection_examples: Repeated network connections to multiple ports.

description: Adversaries may create an account to maintain access to victim systems.
